definition: Technical, institutional or regulatory measures that protect digital systems, networks and data against cyber attack, intrusion or misuse, or that detect and respond to cyber incidents. Includes security operations and incident response teams, technical security controls, identity and access management, encryption, security testing and audits, cybersecurity strategy, law and standards, and security skills for those who run systems. Excludes privacy or data protection rules without a security control, physical protection against theft, vandalism or hazards (resilient_infrastructure_design), and data backup or recovery (disaster_recovery).
